settings.text:
For the person who needs absolutely nothing except a good night's sleep. Four pieces chosen to sit together, packed by hand in our Melbourne studio: a mulberry silk sleep mask and pillowcase cut from the same run, a journal with a page for either end of the day, and a lavender wrap with a good weight to it.

The ritual card sits on top of the tissue, and your message is written on the card by hand. It arrives tied, with no invoice inside and no pricing on the outside. Send it straight to them.

settings.a1_body:
• Silk sleep mask. 22 momme, grade 6A mulberry silk, covered elastic strap, seam on the outside.
  • Silk pillowcase. Standard 48 by 74 cm, same 22 momme silk, cut from the same run as the mask, hidden zip.
  • AM / PM journal. 96 pages, sewn flat so it stays open on a bedside table. A page for the end of the day and a page for the start of the next one.
  • Lavender sleep wrap. Washed linen filled with Australian lavender and wheat. Warm it, or do not. The cover unbuttons and washes.
  • The ritual card. A short evening ritual, letterpressed, the first thing under the lid.
  • Your message. Written by hand on a card that sits on top of the tissue.

settings.heading: Four pieces, one ritual
settings.body: Every piece had to earn its place next to the other three. The silk is cut from one run so the mask and the pillowcase match exactly. The journal has a morning page because the evening page is only half the job. The wrap is filled here, not imported as a finished unit.

settings.text: Rigid box, wrapped in uncoated paper, sturdy enough to be used for something else afterwards.
Printed sleeve, tissue and a ribbon tied by hand. Choose the ribbon at checkout.
No invoice inside and no pricing anywhere on the outside, so it can go straight to them.

settings.heading: A box worth keeping
settings.body:
The packaging is part of the gift rather than something to get through. A rigid keepsake box under a printed sleeve, tissue folded back over the contents, and a ribbon tied on the bench before the lid goes on.

The ritual card is the first thing under the lid, and your message sits on top of it, so your words are the first thing they read.
settings.image_alt: The open box with the lid propped behind it, tissue folded back over the contents

settings.quote: The thing you send when flowers feel like a shrug
settings.body: Sleep Shop is a small studio in Melbourne making beautiful rituals around going to bed. Making one box means we get to be particular about all four pieces in it, and to know exactly where each one comes from.
